# APN Real Estate

> Property management for landlords across Adelaide and Mount Gambier, South Australia, with a named property manager you can reach directly. Formerly Adelaide Property Network. Free rental appraisals.

Adelaide Property Network | RLA 255336

APN Real Estate's property management covers finding and screening tenants, collecting rent, routine and entry/exit inspections, coordinating maintenance and repairs, and keeping owners informed about their property. Management fees depend on the property; ask for a rental appraisal for a specific answer.

Phone: 1300 123 276 (both offices)

## Offices

- [Adelaide](https://apnre.com.au/adelaide/): Level 1 / 420B, Cnr Main North Road and Barton Street, Blair Athol SA 5084
- [Mount Gambier](https://apnre.com.au/mount-gambier/): 178 Commercial Street East, Mount Gambier SA 5290
